study type: Pre- and post-intervention study (interrupted time series design)
exposure: World Health Organization functional class (WHO FC)
cohort: 149 pregnancies in 143 women with pulmonary hypertension.
finding: Implementation of a multidisciplinary team for pregnant women with pulmonary hypertension was associated with a decrease in urgent cesarean sections, heart failure rates, and maternal deaths.
mod_finding: Implementing the MDT decreased the rate of urgent caesarean section.
